name: Tampa
operatingHours: TECO Line Streetcar (Downtown/Whiting ↔ Centennial Park, Ybor City) runs every ~15 min: Mon–Thu 7:00 AM–11:00 PM, Fri 7:00 AM–2:00 AM, Sat 9:00 AM–2:00 AM, Sun 8:30 AM–11:00 PM. End to end takes ~25 min. Extra cars for big events such as Gasparilla.
fareInfo: The TECO Line Streetcar is free: just board, no ticket needed. HART buses (including Route 30 to the airport) cost $2.00 a ride, payable with the Flamingo Fares app or card, or exact cash on board.

sights.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
sights.note: Big Africa-themed theme park and zoo with some of Florida's tallest roller coasters; ~12 km north of downtown, no streetcar link (car or rideshare ~20 min).
sights.hours: Opens 10:00 AM; closes 5:00–10:00 PM depending on date (later on weekends and in late November)

sights.name: The Florida Aquarium
sights.note: Large aquarium on the Channelside waterfront with a coral-reef gallery, a wetlands trail and a shark tank, steps from the Florida Aquarium streetcar stop.
sights.hours: Mon–Thu 10:00 AM–4:00 PM, Fri–Sun 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Thanksgiving & Christmas

sights.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
sights.note: Leafy zoo north of downtown known for its manatee rescue center, Florida wildlife and African and Asian habitats.
sights.hours: 9:30 AM–5:00 PM daily; closed Thanksgiving & Christmas

sights.name: Tampa Riverwalk
sights.note: A 4 km waterfront path along the Hillsborough River linking downtown parks, museums, bars and the Straz Center.

sights.name: Ybor City
sights.note: Tampa's historic Cuban, Spanish and Italian cigar-making quarter: brick streets, cigar shops, free-roaming chickens and the city's liveliest nightlife on 7th Avenue.
sights.hours: Streets always open; 7th Avenue busiest Thu–Sat nights

sights.name: Henry B. Plant Museum
sights.note: Gilded Age interiors inside the Moorish-revival Tampa Bay Hotel of 1891, now the University of Tampa's landmark with silver minarets.
sights.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, Sun noon–5:00 PM, closed Mon

sights.name: Bayshore Boulevard
sights.note: Some 7 km of continuous waterfront sidewalk along Hillsborough Bay, popular for sunset walks, runs and bike rides.

sights.name: Lettuce Lake Park
sights.note: Cypress-swamp boardwalk park on the Hillsborough River where alligators, wading birds and turtles are easy to spot; ~17 km northeast, car needed. Parts of the boardwalk, the observation tower and the canoe launch are closed for repairs.
sights.hours: 8:00 AM–6:00 PM fall/winter, to 7:00 PM spring/summer; $2 per car (cash)

sights.name: Tampa Bay History Center
sights.note: Three floors on Tampa Bay's story, from Native peoples to Cuban cigar workers and a walk-through pirate ship exhibit.

sights.name: Tampa Theatre
sights.note: Ornate 1926 movie palace with a twinkling-star ceiling, just reopened after a restoration for its 100th birthday; films, concerts and guided tours.
sights.hours: Showtimes vary; box office opens before each screening

sights.name: Wat Mongkolratanaram
sights.note: Thai Buddhist temple by the Palm River famous for its Sunday morning Thai food market run by volunteers.
sights.hours: Sunday market ~9:00 AM–1:00 PM (cash only); temple grounds open most days

sights.name: Straz Center for the Performing Arts
sights.note: Riverfront arts complex staging Broadway tours, opera, ballet and concerts across five theaters.
sights.hours: Performance times vary; box office open daily

sights.name: American Victory Ship and Museum
sights.note: A restored 1945 cargo ship you can explore from bridge to engine room, moored next to the Florida Aquarium.
sights.hours: Mon noon–5:00 PM, Tue–Sun 10:00 AM–5:00 PM

sights.name: Sparkman Wharf
sights.note: Waterfront food-and-drink spot built from shipping containers, with a lawn, a beer garden and live music beside the Channelside streetcar stops.
sights.hours: ~11:00 AM–10:00 PM, later on Fri & Sat

sights.name: Armature Works
sights.note: Restored 1910 streetcar barn on the river now hosting the Heights Public Market food hall and a lawn on the Riverwalk's northern end.
sights.hours: ~7:00 AM–10:00 PM, to 11:00 PM Fri & Sat

railStations.name: Tampa Union Station
railStations.note: Tampa's restored 1912 Amtrak station on the edge of downtown and the Channel District. The Floridian runs once a day each way, to Orlando and Miami and north to Washington, DC and Chicago, and Thruway buses connect to other Florida cities. It isn't on the streetcar, but the York Street and Port Tampa stops are ~550–750 m away on foot.
railStations.hours: Station opens around train times; Amtrak trains run on their own timetable

airports.name: Tampa International Airport
airports.transitNote: No rail link to downtown. The SkyConnect people mover runs only inside the airport, linking the main terminal, airsides, parking and the rental car center. HART Route 30 bus ($2.00) goes downtown in ~35–45 min and isn't on the map. A taxi or rideshare takes ~15 min to downtown and ~20 min to Ybor City.
airports.hours: Route 30 runs ~5:30 AM–~10:00 PM, every ~30 min; taxis and rideshare at all hours
